mathematical_semantics: route continuation is a value-of-information decision: continue while expected decision-coordinate change from further items exceeds marginal route cost; stopping binds to the epistemic decision the route serves, never to raw counts of documents or edges processed

transition_semantics: typed outputs ROUTE_CONTINUE | ROUTE_REFORMULATE (flat stream, vocabulary unchallenged) | ROUTE_SWITCH (flat, vocabulary challenged) | ROUTE_EXHAUSTED | ROUTE_BUDGET_STOP (emits CANNOT_CHECK, never flatness); none claims task-level saturation, which only SATURATE.* cells may aggregate over heterogeneous route families
deterministic given (route id, recent per-item decision-coordinate deltas, remaining budget, vocabulary-challenge status) and a registered replaceable marginal-value estimator
